Name: JP's Le Pets - Cat in a Box
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Cat in a Box[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]And he comes and goes in his portable house, who knows what crazy parties happen in those boxes...[/i][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Add 9 adoptable cats, each one comes with its own favorite box, don't even try to take it away. [/size][/font]
[*][size=4]It includes several special meows to give the sensation of a cat inside a box. [/size]
[*][size=4]Have better statistics than the ones you can normally adopt at Marnie's ranch. They cost less gold, require less hearts and are more likely to give you a gift. [/size]
[/list][/font][font=Georgia]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=6][b][u][i]In order to adopt you must do one of these two options:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[/list][list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Reach 5 hearts with the pet Marnie finds.[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4]Rejects the pet Marnie finds [/color]and[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b] wait until day 2 of year 2 to receive a letter from her. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][color=#ff0000][b][size=4][b][i][color=#00ffff]Not much more to add, I hope you like it. [/color][/i][/b][/size]
